note: Messages for swipe.py: every sentence it prints and writes to swipe.md, as str.format templates.

messages.no_rows: no usable rows. Need a tab-separated file with at least views and hook.
messages.note_no_formulas: note: hooks.json not found, formulas not named. Pass --hooks.
messages.note_no_formulas_lang: note: hooks.json has no `match` for {lang} yet, formulas not named. Read the hooks by hand.
messages.note_no_hookscore: note: hookscore.py not importable, hook scores skipped.
messages.note_hookscore_lang: note: hookscore.py not importable for {lang} ({reason}), hook scores skipped.
messages.head: SWIPE FILE  ·  {n} reels  ·  {accounts} accounts  ·  baseline: {baseline}
messages.working_title: WHAT IS WORKING IN THIS BATCH
messages.median_score: median hook score:     top {top:.0f}  vs bottom {bottom:.0f}
messages.median_length: median hook length:    top {top} words  vs bottom {bottom} words
messages.unclassified_line: unclassified:          {count} of {n}. Read those by hand, they are where a formula you do not have yet is hiding.
messages.caveat:
A hand-collected batch is evidence, not proof. Twelve reels shows you nothing;
  forty across six accounts shows you something. Collect more before you believe it.
messages.md_summary: {n} reels across {accounts} accounts. Ranked by multiple over {baseline}.
messages.cta_mark: ^ a call to action, not a hook: capture the cover text or the first spoken line
messages.cta_line: call to action:        {count} of {n}. Their hook is on the cover or in the first spoken line: recapture those.
messages.md_cta: - note: a call to action, not a hook. Take the cover text or the first spoken line.
messages.bad_count: {path}, line {line}: the {column} cell "{cell}" is not a count. Write it as the screen shows it (412K, 1.2M) or in full (412000); nothing was ranked.
